text: So the month of practices aimed at harmonizing the third chakra has come to an end. I hope that you practiced regularly and received fruits in the form of a feeling of expanding life space, your responsibility for life, greater decisiveness, personal strength, discovery of new resources, and so on. Perhaps even in terms of health something has changed for the better… And now I suggest that you not lose the wave and continue the practices! For many years you strengthened a certain way of thinking, values, habits, psychological clichés, and now you have only begun to free yourself from all of that, step by step discovering who you really are. Continuing to move in this direction will, of course, give you deeper results.
